final_report: Investment committee consensus on AAPL: Apple remains a high-quality compounder with strong services margins and a resilient balance sheet. Near-term catalysts include product cycle momentum; key risks include China demand and regulatory pressure on the App Store.

tasks.summary: Macro backdrop for AAPL is supportive with stable rates and healthy consumer spending.
Volatility for AAPL is moderate; position sizing should account for sector beta.
